scope: SQLite and PostgreSQL child-process SIGKILL and durable Team claim recovery
scenario: Child process A opens the real Store journal and claims the task.
The test sends SIGKILL without invoking scheduler close or journal cleanup.
The original lease expires in the shared database or schema.
Child process B opens the same Store and claims with a new owner/epoch.
The journal row and marker prove owner A epoch 1 then owner B epoch 2.

verification.postgresCleanup: stopped and socket rejected a follow-up connection

limitations: This slice proves durable claim recovery, not rollback of an already dispatched external side effect.
The child processes intentionally stop after claim; full executeTeamTask unknown-outcome recovery remains a separate audit.
No default desktop Team or autonomous sub-agent activation is claimed.
